title: Key Cases from over One Thousand Paranormal Investigations Documented in New Non-Fiction Book by Longtime Researcher Cameron Bagg
content:
""People often ask me what keeps me going after all these years, and the answer is simple. The evidence keeps presenting itself. Every investigation adds another piece to a picture that I believe this book finally makes visible to everyone willing to look.""

Cameron Bagg's newly published non-fiction book distills the findings of more than one thousand paranormal investigations conducted over a forty-year career into a single volume of personal narratives and photographic evidence. The work challenges conventional thinking about where and when ghostly phenomena can be observed and recorded.

Peterborough, Ontario, Canada - October 11, 2026 - A new non-fiction book by Cameron Bagg is drawing attention for its ambitious scope and its central claim that ghostly presences can be photographed not just in traditionally haunted locations but anywhere and at any time. The volume is the product of more than four decades of dedicated paranormal investigation, during which Bagg has personally conducted upward of one thousand separate cases.

What distinguishes this book from much of the existing paranormal literature is its reliance on the author's own firsthand experiences rather than compiled accounts from other sources. Bagg has built his career on direct involvement, arriving at locations with cameras and recording equipment, documenting conditions, and cataloging whatever anomalies he encounters. The result is a body of work that he presents as both memoir and evidence portfolio, with each chapter anchored in specific investigations he carried out himself.

The photographic component of the book has generated particular interest. Bagg has assembled images from across his career, many of which he says have never been shared publicly before this publication. The photographs span a wide range of settings and conditions, and each is presented alongside narrative context explaining what was happening during the investigation, what equipment was used, and what Bagg interprets the image as showing. This approach allows readers to evaluate the visual material with the benefit of the investigator's own account of what occurred.

One of the book's more provocative arguments is that the ability to photograph spirits is not limited by geography or time of day. Bagg maintains that his decades of fieldwork have demonstrated a consistency in photographic anomalies that suggests these phenomena are far more pervasive than commonly assumed. He challenges readers to reconsider the idea that paranormal activity is rare or confined to specific types of locations, arguing instead that it is simply overlooked or dismissed by most observers.

The narrative is crafted to appeal to a broad adult readership, with particular resonance for women who have historically shown strong engagement with paranormal non-fiction and personal accounts of unexplained experiences. Bagg writes in a conversational tone that makes complex investigative procedures accessible without sacrificing the detail that more experienced readers expect. The book moves between moments of genuine suspense and quieter passages of reflection on what a lifetime of unusual experiences has meant to the author personally.

Bagg has spoken about his motivation for publishing the book at this point in his career. After decades of accumulating evidence and refining his understanding of the phenomena he investigates, he felt that the time had come to present his strongest material in a single, cohesive work. The book is structured to build a cumulative case, with each chapter adding layers of evidence and argument that Bagg hopes will persuade even skeptical readers to take a closer look at the material.

The volume also touches on the investigative process itself, offering readers insight into how a veteran researcher approaches a new case, what tools are employed, and how findings are assessed after the fact. These procedural sections serve a dual purpose, grounding the more extraordinary claims in practical methodology while giving curious readers a window into a profession that remains largely misunderstood by the general public.

The book is currently available through the Amazon and Kindle website and has begun to generate discussion within online communities devoted to paranormal research and unexplained phenomena.

About Us

Cameron Bagg is a non-fiction author and paranormal investigator whose career spans more than forty years and encompasses over one thousand documented investigations. His published work presents personal experiences and photographic evidence related to unexplained phenomena. Further details can be found at cameronbagg.com.
